{"metadata":{"description":"Blaxel sandbox execution plugin for DeepSeek Harness","id":"gh:1341266924","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"deepseek-harness-blaxel-sandbox","slug":"blaxel-ai/deepseek-harness-blaxel-sandbox","topics":["blaxel","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","remote-execution","sandbox"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Blaxel sandbox execution plugin for DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Blaxel Sandbox for DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Version 0.1.4 moves a DeepSeek Harness Web conversation and its current Git worktree to an independe"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"nt DSH host in a private Blaxel sandbox. Once the cloud page is ready, model requests and tools cont"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"inue there with the originating computer offline. Earlier tools-only versions require the original h"},{"id":"p3s4","text":"ost to stay running."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Use GUIDE.md for setup and recovery, and the cloud handoff contract for implementation status and te"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" setup and recovery, and the cloud handoff contract for implementation status and tested boundaries."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Move, continue, review, return"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"1. Select **Move to Blaxel** in an existing Git-backed conversation. A running task checkpoints afte"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"r its current tool finishes.
2. The plugin restores the project, native conversation history, refere"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"nced images, and supported child-session history in a private cloud host, then opens the same conver"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"sation there.
3. Continue in the cloud page. **Copy private link** provides access from another devi"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"ce; opening from the original computer renews an expired link automatically.
4. On the original comp"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"uter with DSH running, select **Move back to local**. Review changed files and the exact patch, then"},{"id":"p6s7","text":" apply the transfer.
5. The conversation and checked changes return together. The laptop's original "},{"id":"p6s8","text":"permission policy is restored before it resumes. Move to Blaxel again to include newer local work."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"The local copy remains read-only while the cloud owns execution. Compatible local file edits survive"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" the return; conflicts retain both copies and save a recovery patch. Reopening connects to the exist"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"ing sandbox without uploading a new local snapshot."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Session architecture"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Blaxel credentials remain on the original computer. The selected model's portable API key is supplie"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"d to the dedicated cloud process so its agent can run independently. Local-only model endpoints and "},{"id":"p10s3","text":"OAuth grants cannot be handed off by this implementation."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness is in developer preview and its plugin contracts change between release candidates."},{"id":"p12s2","text":" Each plugin release pins one DSH version and is verified against it with the full check, a clean-pr"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"ofile install, and a DSH Web boot."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| Plugin | DSH host | Node.js |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| `0.1.4`, `0.1.3` | `0.1.2-rc.1` | 22.19+, 24+ |
| `0.1.2`, `0.1.1` | `0.1.2-rc.1` | 22, 24 |
| `0."},{"id":"p14s2","text":"1.0` | `0.1.1-rc.2` | 22, 24 |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"When DSH publishes a new version, the plugin is re-verified against it and, when a Host contract mov"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ed, a new plugin release pins the new version. Older hosts keep the last plugin release that pinned "},{"id":"p15s3","text":" new plugin release pins the new version. Older hosts keep the last plugin release that pinned them."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Profile installation"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Install the current plugin into the DSH Web profile with the native helpers it requires:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Development installation"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"`dsh-blaxel` prepares an isolated, pinned DSH 0.1.2-rc.1 runtime on first launch and reuses it after"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"ward. It includes the native history-import extension needed to preserve original timestamps. It use"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"s your existing DSH profile; it does not modify your global DSH installation. Node.js, npm and Git m"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"ust be available. Keep the same `DSH_HOME` if you use a custom profile."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Sign in from **Settings > Blaxel**, or authenticate on the host with `bl login YOUR-WORKSPACE`."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"`pnpm check` runs lint, types, unit tests, build, and publint. `pnpm e2e` additionally boots the pin"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"ned `dsh-blaxel` runtime with the selected profile and runs the Playwright browser smoke suite (`pnp"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"m exec playwright install chromium` once)."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Workspace launch"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"The launch action is available when the session directory is inside a Git worktree. It:"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"1. Lists tracked files and unignored untracked files.
2. Excludes common credential and private-key "},{"id":"p26s2","text":"paths.
3. Creates a bounded archive without `.git` or `.dsh-blaxel` state.
4. Restores the worktree "},{"id":"p26s3","text":"under `/workspace` in a Blaxel sandbox.
5. Restores the same native session ID in a dedicated cloud "},{"id":"p26s4","text":"DSH process.
6. Opens its authenticated private preview after the cloud host is ready."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"The launch panel reports real file counts and the active phase. A failed launch stays in the current"},{"id":"p27s2","text":" session with its error instead of creating an empty page."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Before any sandbox is created, the plugin verifies that the session's selected model route is active"},{"id":"p28s2","text":" and that its resolved credential is configured. If a writable credential is missing, the composer s"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"hows a secure provider-specific setup card. Saving the key writes it to the DSH host credential stor"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"e, verifies the model again, and continues the original sandbox action. The selected portable model "},{"id":"p28s5","text":"API key is forwarded to the cloud process; it is never returned to the browser. Blaxel credentials r"},{"id":"p28s6","text":"orwarded to the cloud process; it is never returned to the browser. Blaxel credentials remain local."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"| Variable | Default | Purpose |
|---|---:|---|
| `DSH_BLAXEL_IMAGE` | `blaxel/ts-app:latest` | Sand"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"box image |
| `DSH_BLAXEL_MEMORY` | `4096` | Sandbox memory in MB |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## Security and lifecycle"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- Blaxel authentication remains host-side.
- Local sessions retain DSH's local sandbox policy.
- San"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"dbox sessions route to the remote filesystem and subprocess providers. A failed remote operation nev"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"er falls back to the host.
- Git-ignored files and common credential files such as `.env`, `.npmrc`,"},{"id":"p32s4","text":" private keys, and credential JSON are omitted from workspace snapshots.
- A running task checkpoint"},{"id":"p32s5","text":"s at a safe tool boundary before continuing on the cloud host.
- Moving is an explicit round trip, n"},{"id":"p32s6","text":"ot continuous synchronization. `Return to local` conflict-checks sandbox changes against the origina"},{"id":"p32s7","text":"l worktree, applies them only when safe, stops that sandbox, and keeps the same DSH session local. T"},{"id":"p32s8","text":"he session can later move into a fresh sandbox again.
- Each runtime is deleted only when stopped. R"},{"id":"p32s9","text":"estarting DSH reconnects the same native session to its existing sandbox.
- Reconnecting keeps exist"},{"id":"p32s10","text":"ing sandbox files and does not upload newer local edits. To bring local work into that session, move"},{"id":"p32s11","text":" back to local, merge any conflicts, then move to Blaxel again. See the file-change scenarios.
- Tel"},{"id":"p32s12","text":"emetry is limited to attribution: Blaxel API and sandbox requests carry the Blaxel SDK `User-Agent` "},{"id":"p32s13","text":"with `deepseek-harness-blaxel-sandbox/<version>` appended. Nothing is collected from DSH, the conver"},{"id":"p32s14","text":"sation, or the workspace."}],"truncated":true}
